description: This file contains classes and methods for aggregating responses from a Large Language Model (LLM), including handling conversation context, message accumulation, and managing function calls and interruptions within a conversational AI pipeline.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for configuring user-specific LLM response aggregation behavior, including timeout settings and emulated VAD options.

classes.name: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for configuring assistant-specific LLM response aggregation, such as handling stripped words.

classes.name: LLMFullResponseAggregator
classes.description: Aggregates complete LLM responses between start and end frames, providing an event when a full response is assembled.

classes.name: BaseLLMResponseAggregator
classes.description: Abstract base class for all LLM response aggregators, managing message storage and response handling.

classes.name: LLMContextResponseAggregator
classes.description: Uses an OpenAI LLM context for storing conversation state and managing context frames; deprecated in favor of universal LLMContext.

classes.name: LLMUserContextAggregator
classes.description: Handles user speech transcription aggregation, managing VAD emulation, interruptions, and context updates; deprecated in favor of universal LLMContext.

classes.name: LLMUserResponseAggregator
classes.description: Extends user context aggregator to output message frames instead of context frames; deprecated.

classes.name: LLMAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: Handles assistant responses, including text aggregation, function call management, and timestamping; deprecated.

classes.name: LLMAssistantResponseAggregator
classes.description: Extends assistant context aggregator to output message frames, managing function calls and timestamping; deprecated.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, managing aggregation, context updates, and function call states.

methods.name: push_aggregation
methods.description: Pushes the current message or context aggregation downstream, including timestamping.

methods.name: _handle_llm_start
methods.description: Handles the start of an LLM response, incrementing response count.

methods.name: _handle_llm_end
methods.description: Handles the end of an LLM response, decrementing response count and pushing aggregation.

methods.name: _handle_text
methods.description: Aggregates text frames into the response buffer, considering whether to append with space.

methods.name: _handle_llm_messages_append
methods.description: Adds messages to the context and optionally triggers a new response.

methods.name: _handle_llm_messages_update
methods.description: Replaces current messages in the context and optionally triggers a new response.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions
methods.description: Handles interruption frames, pushing current aggregation and resetting state.

methods.name: _handle_function_calls_started
methods.description: Tracks function calls that have started.

methods.name: _handle_function_call_in_progress
methods.description: Tracks a function call that is currently in progress.

methods.name: _handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles the result of a completed function call, possibly triggering further responses.

methods.name: _handle_function_call_cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a function call.

methods.name: _handle_user_image_frame
methods.description: Handles user image frames related to function calls.

methods.name: _create_aggregation_task
methods.description: Creates an asyncio task to handle response timeout and aggregation.

methods.name: _cancel_aggregation_task
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing aggregation timeout task.

methods.name: _aggregation_task_handler
methods.description: Main loop waiting for timeout or events to finalize and push response aggregation.

methods.name: _maybe_emulate_user_speaking
methods.description: Emulates user speaking based on transcription and VAD status.

methods.name: _context_updated_task_finished
methods.description: Callback to remove completed context update tasks.
